The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The reported fixed Parik24 promotional banner could not be reproduced:⁠ the reported page loads fine in the reporter's own filter profile (both Ukrainian and Russian locales) and in an unfiltered control, and full-page vision plus DOM inspection find no fixed/promo overlay or any banner-like element, only an already-blocked ad rotator producing empty zones. Recommend closing without a rule.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The run instruction states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not another anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing report, so rule generation was open (allow_rule_generation). No rule of the repository policy as stated in the run instruction blocks the fix; the close recommendation rests on reproduction evidence, not on a policy gate.
